disturbance_trace: d[t]=0.22*sin(2*pi*t/12)+0.18*sin(2*pi*t/7); identical t-indexed trace for every schedule
schedule_enumeration: all unique permutations of [0,1,2,5] as circular inter-miss gap tuples; gap 0 means adjacent misses; start with a miss at index 0; for the first three gaps add gap+1 modulo 12; final gap closes the cycle
split: sorted gap tuple lexical order, first 16 train, last 8 heldout
feature: maximum number of misses in any circular 4-tick window
threshold_selection: among integer thresholds 1..4, require zero false-safe on train; choose largest threshold (least conservative) meeting constraint; no qualifying threshold => no predictor
baselines: mean miss rate and p95 latency identical by construction; freshness-age gap-multiset histogram identical by construction
execution: native Windows Python construction only while WSLc image inspect/list control plane is nonresponsive; no product/live/model claim
decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if heldout has at least one safe and one unsafe case and zero false-safe with predictor, while both baselines cannot distinguish schedules; FAIL_REDUNDANT if no distinct heldout separation; UNCERTAIN_TRANSFER if simulator/oracle assumptions fail independent audit
scope: finite synthetic method only; no T1 trace transfer and no #59 allocation
